## What lands

K2 GX-05b — the second half of the `sig.entity-page/1` data contract (§4.2 rows 8/9/11/12, §6.2):

- **Kind extension:** `PAGE_KINDS` gains the E2 wave — `notice`, `contract`, `grant`, `bill`, `policy` (legal instruments/ordinances), `event` (accountability events/agenda items). `atlas` (E3) and `request` stay outside this row; the SQL-side `entity_page_claims` superset gains the same subject-key families `policy.labels._KIND_PREFIXES` resolves.
- **`timeline[]`** — stated event dates (registry `edtf`-typed predicates: posted/signed/award/bill-status/effective), record observations on claim groups, relation items and degree facts, first/last seen per source (`claim_sightings`). Undated items list as `date: null` — never drawn, never present-tense (SIG-UI-116/H-3).
- **`contradictions[]`** — every materialized §31 contradiction on the subject or a claim of the entity's, plus resolution-envelope conflicts not already covered; both sides' claim ids kept visible, never silently reconciled (H-7 / SIG-RECON-055 / SIG-UI-009).
- **`related{}`** — the recorded place's dossier (keyed registry slug path), the cited sources (`/sources/<id>/`), research-queue tasks (the queue's own minted K11 handles — consumed, never re-derived), claim-bound evidence documents; `watch` stays typed-empty (no entity-scoped watch seam).
- **`downloads[]`** — names only files the export emits: `index.<comp>.json`, `relationships.<comp>.json` (`sig.entity-relationships/1`), `relationships.<comp>.csv`, `statements.<comp>.jsonl` (the `sig.statement/1` stream sliced on `entity_id`). Every claim-keyed section files per compartment only where every named claim licenses there (ADR-106, `_file_by_claims`). `entity_relationships` registers in the column registry (SIG-TRANSP-016).
- **Web mirror + render:** `entity-page.ts` types/fixture + `isEntityPageTwin` fail-closed on a missing slot; `mergeEntityTwins` unions the sections per compartment; `entityTimeline` reads `merged.timeline` as authoritative (derivation fallback for legacy twins); the entity page renders Disagreements, timeline entries, related links and the downloads rows SSR with the typed absence kept — still T1, no new script, no route added (page-type budget exporter untouched).
